end.summary:
Siya described health as physical, mental and social well-being, not only being free from illness.
They used sleep, loneliness, food, happiness and friendship as examples.
They linked walking and football to physical and social health, and sleep to mental health.
Habit-to-health links were only partly practised; the teach-back was not completed because the lesson ended early.
end.parentNote: Siya practised explaining health through physical, mental and social well-being and gave relevant examples from sleep, food, activity and relationships. They also noticed that one habit, such as walking with a friend, can affect more than one part of health. The discussion about linking each daily habit to a health area was not completed, and no mix-up was fully checked after the last response. At home, ask Siya to make a three-column list—physical, mental and social—and place five daily habits in one or more columns.
